Description: A short, searing opinion, delivered directly to the face. Nobody asked. It burns anyway.
Tome text: A pamphlet titled YOU'RE ALL WRONG. The pages are warm and slightly greasy.
What it does at level 1, before INT (fro: 2/3/5 fire damage · close · burning 2 rounds (30% on a solid hit, always on a great one)
Starts with it (from the game): once started a campfire with two sticks and then the woods

Description: Flings a ladle of burning fry oil across the room. Health inspectors hate this one weird trick.
Tome text: A laminated restaurant safety poster, every DON'T crossed out and replaced with DO.
What it does at level 1, before INT (fro: 3/5/7 fire damage · near · burning 2 rounds (40% on a solid hit, always on a great one)
Starts with it (from the game): gas company technician; once won a state spelling bee by correctly spelling a word nobody has used since

Description: Summons the general vibe of a burning dumpster onto a patch of floor, and everyone standing on it. Leaves it burning.
Tome text: A binder of quarterly reports. Every chart goes down and to the right, and the binder is on fire.
What it does at level 1, before INT (fro: 2/3/5 fire damage to everything on a plus of five tiles · near · burning 2 rounds (50% on a solid hit, always on a great one) · leaves fire behind

Description: You ignore something so hard its joints frost over. Works best on people who need your approval.
Tome text: A greeting card that just says 'k.' It's cold to the touch and leaves a ring on things.
What it does at level 1, before INT (fro: 2/3/4 frost damage · close · slowed 1 round (40% on a solid hit, always on a great one)
Starts with it (from the game): once self-published a fantasy trilogy and sold forty copies, thirty to your aunt

Description: A blast of the air from the back of a gas station freezer, plus whatever's been living back there since 2009.
Tome text: A frost-crusted instruction manual for a chest freezer. Chapter one: Who Is In Here With You.
What it does at level 1, before INT (fro: 3/4/6 frost damage · near · slowed 2 rounds (50% on a solid hit, always on a great one)

Description: Turns a chunk of the room into the walk-in at closing time: dark, freezing, and nobody's coming to let you out.
Tome text: A clipboard of temperature logs, all initialed by the same employee who quit in March.
What it does at level 1, before INT (fro: 1/3/4 frost damage to everything on a 3×3 square · near · slowed 2 rounds (60% on a solid hit, always on a great one)

Description: The shock you get from a doorknob in January, scaled up for a hostile audience. Occasionally locks them up.
Tome text: A wool sock wrapped around a 9-volt battery. The sock crackles when you open it.
What it does at level 1, before INT (fro: 2/5/7 lightning damage · near · stunned 1 round (15% on a solid hit, always on a great one)
Starts with it (from the game): electrician; local weatherman; once own every card from a 1995 collectible card game and know their stats

Description: Something that was never up to code, now aimed. Arcs to the next idiot standing nearby.
Tome text: A home inspection report with one finding, circled eleven times: EVERYTHING.
What it does at level 1, before INT (fro: 2/4/6 lightning damage · near · arcs to 1 more nearby for half

Description: The surge that fried your mom's computer in 1998, delivered across the whole room. Sometimes they stop moving for a bit.
Tome text: A power strip with every outlet melted shut. The warranty card is still attached, unfilled.
What it does at level 1, before INT (fro: 4/6/9 lightning damage · far · stunned 1 round (25% on a solid hit, always on a great one)

Description: You touch them and their blood decides it would rather be outside. Up close and personal.
Tome text: A family Bible with every name in the front scratched out except yours. Yours is in pencil.
What it does at level 1, before INT (fro: 1/2/4 necrotic damage · close · bleeding 3 rounds (50% on a solid hit, always on a great one)

Description: Withdraws health from somebody else's account and deposits half of it in yours. Fees apply. To them.
Tome text: A stack of overdraft notices addressed to a dead man. The latest is dated tomorrow.
What it does at level 1, before INT (fro: 2/4/6 necrotic damage · near · heals you 50% of the damage

Description: The two certainties, applied to a crowd. You collect a little of what it takes, and what's left goes septic.
Tome text: A tax return for the whole dungeon. Under 'dependents' it lists every crawler. Under 'deductions', the same.
What it does at level 1, before INT (fro: 1/3/4 necrotic damage to everything on a plus of five tiles · near · poisoned 3 rounds (40% on a solid hit, always on a great one) · heals you 25% of the damage

Description: No flash photography, the sign said. You did it anyway, into their eyes. Things that hate light hate this more.
Tome text: A disposable camera with one shot left. The counter says 0. It still clicks.
What it does at level 1, before INT (fro: 2/4/6 light damage · near · blinded 1 round (50% on a solid hit, always on a great one) · +2 against undead and light-sensitive things
Starts with it (from the game): planetarium guide; once bought a ghost-hunting kit online and detected only your own microwave

Description: Applies a small fix to you. Known issues remain. The developers appreciate your patience.
Tome text: A printed changelog for your own body. Version 1.0.1: 'fixed a bug where the player was alive.'
What it does at level 1, before INT (fro: heals 3/5/8

Description: Every bank of lights at a high school football game, switched on in one corner of the room. The undead take it personally.
Tome text: A booster club program with the halftime show crossed out and a sacrifice penciled in.
What it does at level 1, before INT (fro: 1/2/3 light damage to everything on a 3×3 square · near · blinded 1 round (60% on a solid hit, always on a great one) · +3 against undead and light-sensitive things

Description: Wraps you in a layer of invisible bubble wrap. Hits land softer. You will want to pop it. Don't.
Tome text: A shipping manifest for one (1) crawler, FRAGILE, THIS SIDE UP, contents not insured.
What it does at level 1, before INT (fro: you: shielded for 2 rounds

Description: Kills 99.9% of what's killing you: poison, bleeding, burning. The other 0.1% is your fault.
Tome text: A pump bottle from a hospital lobby, chained to a pamphlet. You read the pamphlet. The bottle comes with it.
What it does at level 1, before INT (fro: cures poisoned, bleeding, burning

Description: A legally binding shimmer. Things find you harder to hit, and anything that touches you anyway gets served.
Tome text: A court document with your name on both sides. The judge's signature is a drawing of a little fist.
What it does at level 1, before INT (fro: you: warded for 3 rounds

Description: Shows one monster something it wants, standing right where its friend is. Confused, it might swing at either.
Tome text: A furniture store catalogue where every price is a lie, and the couch on the cover is a cardboard cutout.
What it does at level 1, before INT (fro: confused for 1/2/3 rounds by tier · near

Description: A cheap trick, a loud noise and a face in the dark. Cheap tricks work. Whatever sees it wants to be somewhere else.
Tome text: A DVD case for a horror movie that never came out. The disc inside is just a recording of you, sleeping.
What it does at level 1, before INT (fro: everything on a plus of five tiles: feared for 1/2/3 rounds by tier · near

Description: This attack is brought to you by you. For a couple of rounds, the target is a brand ambassador and won't hurt the brand.
Tome text: A media kit for an influencer with zero followers. Under 'audience' it just says 'them'.
What it does at level 1, before INT (fro: charmed for 1/2/3 rounds by tier · near

Description: Turns your blood into a quad-shot americano for a couple of rounds. You move faster. Your heart files a complaint.
Tome text: A loyalty card with nine stamps. The tenth square says 'death'. It's already stamped.
What it does at level 1, before INT (fro: you: hasted for 2 rounds

Description: Briefly converts the air around something into a heritage-brand breakfast syrup. It gets one less AP and an attitude.
Tome text: A jar label for a molasses that went out of business in a flood. A real flood. Of molasses.
What it does at level 1, before INT (fro: slowed for 1/2/3 rounds by tier · near

Description: Turns a monster's hide into something more like a cheap steak. Everything lands cleaner and digs deeper.
Tome text: A butcher's apron with a recipe printed on it. The recipe's main ingredient is the reader.
What it does at level 1, before INT (fro: tenderized for 1/3/4 rounds by tier · near

Description: Your palm becomes a phone flashlight with 4% battery. Whatever's hidden in this room, you see it now. Takes no time.
Tome text: A phone with a cracked screen and one app installed. It has three stars and four thousand reviews, all of them 'it works'.
What it does at level 1, before INT (fro: turns up what's hidden in this room, instantly

Description: The hair on your neck starts doing your job for you. For the next few rooms, you spot traps as you walk in.
Tome text: A fortune cookie slip that says DON'T. The other side says SERIOUSLY.
What it does at level 1, before INT (fro: you: bad feeling for 6 rooms
Starts with it (from the game): once were in a psychology study about obedience and passed, or failed

Description: A coat hanger that twitches toward the way down. Hidden stairwells within a few rooms show up on your map.
Tome text: A bent wire coat hanger with a price tag from a church rummage sale: 25 cents, or best offer.
What it does at level 1, before INT (fro: marks hidden stairwells within 3 rooms
